column2: [intro]
In my head, it's always a blur
I take the big leap, but I lose the taste
Between yes and no, it's indecision
I move forward gropingly, in this confusion
It's complicated, I'm sorry
Sometimes I'm lost, I have no opinion
Life is like that, I didn't choose
I dance to the rhythm of my hesitations
The choices are many, but I'm stuck
I change my mind every time I'm questioned
I try to understand, to find my way
But I'm lost, like a fish in water
It's complicated, I'm sorry
Sometimes I'm lost, I have no opinion
Life is like that, I didn't choose
I dance to the rhythm of my hesitations
[ solo ]
And there you have it, my friends, that's life in indecision
You can never be sure of anything, can you?
Come on, let's dance!
Life is too short to take too seriously.
[ outro ]
